info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Business Analysi Product Portfolio-spec
info.description: The Business Analysis Product Portfolio API enables organizations to develop and manage their product portfolios effectively. This endpoint supports the creation of a new product portfolio tailored to meet specific business analysis needs. It is particularly useful for project managers and analysts looking to consolidate product information and drive strategic decision-making. By leveraging this API, users can enhance their ability to respond to market demands and optimize their product offerings.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new product portfolio by providing the necessary details. Ensure that all required fields are filled in order to successfully add the portfolio to the system.
